procedural_matters: GER 36382 was represented by Jan Marten (helm).
ITA 36342 was represented by Cosimo D'Incecco (helm).
Max Preinesberger, helm of GER 35834, gave evidence.
facts: In Vaurien worlds race 10 the wind was approximately 10-12 knots with 30cm waves.
On the beat to windward GER 36382 was sailing on starboard close-hauled tack on a converging course with ITA 36342, who was sailing on port close-hauled tack.
When the distance between them was half a boat length, ITA 36342 started to luff and passed head to wind.
When ITA 36342 reached a close-hauled course, she was clear ahead of GER 36382 by 20cm.
Then GER 36382 luffed and passed head to wind.
There was no contact or injury.
conclusions: When acquiring right-of-way through her own actions, ITA 36342 gave GER 36382 room to keep clear, and complied with RRS 15.
GER 36382 clear astern kept clear of ITA 36342 clear ahead, and complied with RRS 12.
